title: Template sources
lead: Where the project wizard gets templates besides the ones built into the Studio: a git repository or an archive. New versions appear without a rebuild or restart.

sources.title: Connected sources
sources.lead: Check first: the Studio loads the source and shows which template versions will appear. Apply connects exactly what you checked.
sources.emptyLead: A source is a git repository or an archive with templates. Connect the first one and its templates appear in the project wizard.

source.disabledHint: The source's templates are hidden from the project wizard. Versions stay for existing projects.
source.trackingHint: Once a day the Studio checks the source and applies new released versions.
source.notApplied: Not connected yet: check and apply
source.noPacks: No templates yet: check and apply the source.

pack.versionHiddenHint: The version is there for existing projects, but the wizard does not offer it.

others.title: Other templates in the Studio
others.lead: Built into the Studio or left from removed sources. Here they are view-only.

add.title: Add source
add.lead: After adding, the source must be checked and applied: until then its templates do not appear in the wizard.
add.label: Name
add.labelHint: How the source is named in the list. Empty: from the address or file name.
add.packsPathGitHint: Path to the templates folder from the repository root.
add.packsPathArchiveHint: Path to the templates folder inside the archive. Empty: the archive root.
add.refHint: A tag, branch or commit. Empty: the main branch. A tag is safer: its content does not change.
add.credentialEmpty: You have no git access for this address. Add one under Git access in the settings.
add.serviceEmpty: No connected repositories. Connect one in the Template Studio section.
add.replaceBuiltinHint: A template with the same id as one built into the Studio replaces it in the wizard. Without the checkbox such a template is not connected.
add.trackHint: The Studio checks the source itself and applies new released versions if nothing prevents it.
add.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than {{size}}: such an archive is refused.

edit.title: Edit “{{name}}”
edit.lead: Changing the version in the repository, the templates folder or the built-in replacement resets the last check: the source must be checked again.

replace.title: Replace the archive of “{{name}}”
replace.lead: Check and apply the new archive. Versions already in the catalog stay.

remove.title: Remove “{{name}}”?
remove.lead: The source's templates disappear from the project wizard. Versions stay in storage: existing projects keep working on them.
